claims.claim_text: Management committees evidenced in the governance structure include the Group Sustainability Committee, ESG Executive Committee, and Climate Risk Management Committee.
claims.support_notes: Each committee name is directly evidenced by governance management committee name fields.

claims.claim_text: These committees provide governance forums through which sustainability-related and climate-related risk topics may be reviewed and escalated through the governance structure, as applicable.
claims.support_notes: No evidence item supports the functional role (review/escalation forums) of the committees; available evidence only lists committee names.

claims.claim_text: The climate risk register is a record used to document climate-related risk items and associated references to relevant disclosure requirements.
claims.support_notes: No evidence item defines the climate risk register; evidence items only show IFRS S2 paragraph references within register entries.

claims.claim_text: Evidence from the climate risk register indicates that multiple entries reference IFRS S2 §25(a).
claims.support_notes: Eight climate risk register evidence fields show §25(a), supporting that multiple entries reference IFRS S2 §25(a).
